cnTitle: 紫微斗数十二宫怎么记最快：把十二宫想成人生的十二个剧场
enTitle: How to Memorize the Twelve Palaces in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Twelve Stages of Life
enDesc: The twelve palaces are not isolated labels. They are twelve facets of one life, and learning their opposite-palace pairs beats rote memorization.
cnDesc: 十二宫不是十二张孤立标签，而是同一件事在不同人生面向上的分工，记住宫位之间的对宫关系，比死背顺序更重要。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数身宫是什么：身宫和命宫到底差在哪
enTitle: What Is the Body Palace in Zi Wei Dou Shu, and How It Differs from the Life Palace
enDesc: The Life Palace is your innate baseline while the Body Palace is the direction you grow toward; it is attached to one of six palaces and shows where your focus shifts after your mid-thirties.
cnDesc: 命宫是天生的底色，身宫是后天越活越靠近的方向，身宫寄在六个宫位上，提醒你三十五岁后重心往哪移。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数三方四正为什么是看盘骨架：单宫不成命
enTitle: Why the Triple-Direction Is the Backbone of a Zi Wei Dou Shu Reading
enDesc: Every palace must be read with its wealth position, career position and opposite palace. The home palace is center stage, but the triple-direction is the whole cast.
cnDesc: 任何一宫都要拉上它的财帛位、官禄位和对宫一起看，本宫只是舞台中央，三方四正才是这台戏的完整班底。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数排盘为什么用农历：用错历法整张盘都偏
enTitle: Why Zi Wei Dou Shu Uses the Lunar Calendar: The Wrong Calendar Shifts the Whole Chart
enDesc: Zi Wei places the Life and Body palaces and stars by lunar month and hour. Feeding a solar birthday directly can shift the Life Palace and stars, and leap months need special handling.
cnDesc: 紫微按阴历的月和时辰安命身、布星曜，直接拿公历生日排盘，命宫位置和星曜都可能错，闰月还要特别处理。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数庙旺落陷是什么意思：星曜的亮度不等于吉凶
enTitle: Miao, Wang and Fall in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Star Brightness Is Not Good or Bad
enDesc: Exaltation means a star expresses its strength in a palace; fall means it is constrained. Yet a fallen auspicious star is not always bad and an empowered malefic can do more damage—read them in combination.
cnDesc: 庙旺是星曜在某个宫位力量舒展，落陷是力量受限，但吉星落陷也未必坏、煞星得地反而更有破坏力，要组合着看。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数生年四化怎么定一张盘的底色
enTitle: How the Natal Four Transformations Set the Baseline of a Zi Wei Chart
enDesc: The natal Four Transformations come from your birth-year stem. Where Lu, Quan, Ke and Ji land shows where you repeatedly experience gain, control, reputation and blockage across life.
cnDesc: 生年四化由出生年天干决定，化禄化权化科化忌落在哪个宫，这一生就反复在那件事上体验收获、掌控、名声与卡点。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数大限四化怎么定十年方向：别把阶段主题当一生
enTitle: How Decade-Limit Transformations Set a Ten-Year Direction
enDesc: Each decade limit has its own stem and transformations, concentrating resources, control, reputation and blockage on one matter for ten years before the theme shifts.
cnDesc: 每个十年大限有自己的天干和四化，它决定这十年资源、权力、名声、卡点集中在哪件事上，大限一过主题就换。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数化禄不是天上掉钱：资源要经过哪个宫才到手
enTitle: Hua Lu in Zi Wei Dou Shu Is Not Free Money: How Resources Actually Reach You
enDesc: Hua Lu marks the doorway to affinity, opportunity and resources, but its palace decides their form; whether they convert into results depends on the Career and Life palaces.
cnDesc: 化禄代表缘分、机会和资源的入口，但它落在哪个宫，资源就以哪种形式来，能不能变现还要看官禄和命宫接不接得住。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数化权：权力的背面是责任，掌控感从哪来
enTitle: Hua Quan in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Behind Power Lies Responsibility
enDesc: Hua Quan makes its palace's matters heavier and more active, granting control while loading responsibility; wherever it lands, you must take charge there.
cnDesc: 化权让所在宫位的事变重、变主动，给你掌控力也压上责任，它落在哪个领域，你就要在那个领域当家、扛事。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数化科：名声、考试与缓和，为什么它能给事情留余地
enTitle: Hua Ke in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Reputation, Exams and the Room It Leaves for Things
enDesc: Hua Ke governs reputation, helpful people, documents and exams, and smoothing. It gives no direct resource or power, yet makes things look better, run smoother and leave a graceful way out.
cnDesc: 化科主名声、贵人、文书考试与缓和，它不直接给资源或权力，却能让事情好看一点、平顺一点、有台阶下。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数化忌不是坏：它是你最在意也最容易卡住的地方
enTitle: Hua Ji Is Not Evil: It Is What You Care Most About and Get Stuck On
enDesc: Hua Ji stands for convergence, fixation, a sense of owing and blockage; whichever palace it lands is where you obsess and drain—and where your life lesson lies.
cnDesc: 化忌代表收敛、执念、欠债感与卡点，落在哪宫你就对哪类事特别执着、特别容易内耗，看懂它就知道此生的功课。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数禄忌对冲怎么读：得到和牵挂为什么总在同一条线
enTitle: How to Read a Lu-Ji Clash in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Why Gain and Attachment Share One Line
enDesc: When Lu and Ji sit in opposite palaces or on one line, resource and blockage arrive bound together—you gain in one place while being pulled by it; read the cost before taking it.
cnDesc: 化禄与化忌落在对宫或同一条线时，资源和卡点会绑在一起出现，表现为一边得到、一边被它牵住，关键是看清代价再决定拿不拿。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数空宫不是没运：借对宫之前先把三方看全
enTitle: An Empty Palace in Zi Wei Dou Shu Is Not No Luck: Borrow the Opposite After Reading the Whole Triple-Direction
enDesc: An empty palace holds none of the fourteen major stars and borrows its opposite's major star, but borrowing only the opposite reads thin; the whole triple-direction shows how stable that borrowed star is.
cnDesc: 空宫指本宫没有十四主星，要借对宫主星来读，但只借对宫会读薄，必须连同三方四正一起，才知道借来的星稳不稳。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数立太极是什么：换一个宫当命宫，整件事就换了视角
enTitle: What "Resetting the Taiji" Means in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Re-Centering on Another Palace Changes the Whole View
enDesc: To examine a matter, treat its palace as a new Life Palace and re-map the twelve around it; centering on the Career palace, for example, reveals that matter's own resources, process and outcome.
cnDesc: 想看哪一类事，就以那个宫为新的命宫重排十二宫，比如看事业以官禄宫立太极，就能读出这件事本身的资源、过程与结果。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数拿到一张盘先看什么：正确顺序比死记星性更重要
enTitle: What to Read First in a Zi Wei Chart: Order Matters More Than Memorizing Star Meanings
enDesc: The right order is verify the chart and Life/Body palaces, then major stars and patterns with the triple-direction, then natal transformations for tone, and finally cycles for timing; reading out of order skews the picture.
cnDesc: 正确顺序是先定盘与命身宫，再看主星格局与三方四正，接着生年四化定底色，最后大限流年定时间，乱序就容易以偏概全。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数主星不弱但煞星很多：先定主轴还是先判风险
enTitle: Strong Major Star but Many Malefics in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Main Line First or Risk First
enDesc: The major star sets your main line and ability; malefics set friction and cost along the way. A stable major star turns many malefics into struggle rather than collapse—confirm the main line, then assess how the malefics operate.
cnDesc: 主星决定一个人的主轴和能力，煞星决定过程中的摩擦与代价，主星稳则煞星多表现为折腾而非崩盘，读法是先认主轴再评估煞星怎么用。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数吉星多就一定命好吗：吉星也要看场合和主轴
enTitle: Do Many Auspicious Stars Guarantee a Good Fate in Zi Wei Dou Shu? Context and Main Line Matter
enDesc: Auspicious stars are help and opportunity, but too many around a weak major star can mean every chance appears and none is taken deeply; they work only when hung on a clear main line.
cnDesc: 吉星是助力和机会，但吉星过多而主星无力，反而容易「什么机会都有、什么都抓不深」，吉星要挂在一条清晰主轴上才有用。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数时辰不准怎么定盘：用性格和大事把时辰校回来
enTitle: How to Verify a Zi Wei Chart When the Birth Hour Is Uncertain
enDesc: When the hour is uncertain, do not force a verdict; cast the two adjacent hours and compare personality, family and major past turning points against each—the chart that fits the facts is the right one.
cnDesc: 时辰不确定时不要硬断，可用相邻两个时辰分别排盘，再用性格、六亲、过往重大转折逐年比对，最贴合事实的那张就是对的盘。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数紫府同宫是真格还是假格：帝星逢府库还要看辅佐
enTitle: Is Zi-Fu Tong Gong a Real Pattern in Zi Wei Dou Shu? The Emperor and the Treasury Still Need Support
enDesc: Zi Wei and Tian Fu sharing Yin or Shen is only the ticket to the pattern; it becomes real when the trine brings Zuo Fu, You Bi and other auspicious stars and a decade activates it. A lone emperor with no aides tends to guard without strength.
cnDesc: 紫微天府在寅申同宫只是成格的门票，三方得左辅右弼等吉星、且大限引动才算真格，孤君无辅的紫府同宫反而容易守成无力。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数阳梁昌禄格为什么利考试：清贵、文星与资源的交会
enTitle: Why the Yang-Liang-Chang-Lu Pattern Favors Exams in Zi Wei Dou Shu
enDesc: When Tai Yang, Tian Liang, Wen Chang and Lu Cun meet across the triple-direction, the pattern favors scholarly distinction and exams—academia and public examinations—provided all four meet without heavy malefics breaking it.
cnDesc: 太阳、天梁、文昌、禄存在三方四正交会，主清贵功名与科甲，利于考试、学术、公职竞考，但成格要四星会齐且无重煞破坏。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数火贪格暴发也要守得住：爆发力之外看风控和心性
enTitle: The Huo-Tan Pattern's Sudden Rise Must Be Defended: Beyond Burst Power, Look at Risk Control and Temperament
enDesc: Tan Lang meeting Huo Xing (or Ling Xing) forms Huo-Tan, marking sudden opportunity and unconventional success; the position, wealth stars in the trine and malefic checks set its level, while keeping the gains depends on temperament and risk control.
cnDesc: 贪狼遇火星（或铃星）成火贪格，主突发机遇与异路功名，但成格位置、三方财星与煞星制衡决定层级，暴发后能否守住更看心性与风控。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数三奇佳会格为什么少见：化禄化权化科同聚有多难
enTitle: Why the San Qi Jia Hui Pattern Is Rare in Zi Wei Dou Shu: How Hard It Is for Lu, Quan and Ke to Converge
enDesc: When Hua Lu, Hua Quan and Hua Ke meet across the Life triple-direction it is San Qi Jia Hui—a complete structure of name and gain. Because the three come from different sources and Hua Ji must not break it, the bar is high.
cnDesc: 化禄化权化科在命宫三方四正交会称三奇佳会，主名利双全的完整结构，但三化来源不同、还要不被化忌破坏，成格门槛很高。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数有格局却一直平庸：成格之后还要被大限引动
enTitle: Why a Good Zi Wei Pattern Can Still Feel Ordinary: A Pattern Must Be Activated by a Decade
enDesc: A pattern is static structure—a possibility only. It becomes a real event when a decade or year sends transformations or auspicious stars across to activate it.
cnDesc: 格局是命盘里的静态结构，只代表「具备这种可能」，要等大限流年的四化或吉星走到，把它引动，潜力才会变成现实事件。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数一个煞星能不能毁掉整个格局：破格要看位置和有没有救
enTitle: Can One Malefic Destroy a Whole Zi Wei Pattern? Breaking a Pattern Depends on Position and Rescue
enDesc: Whether a malefic breaks a pattern depends on which link it hits, whether it shares the palace or only the trine, and whether Hua Ke/Quan or auspicious stars control it; one hit does not ruin the whole.
cnDesc: 煞星是否破格，要看它落在格局的哪个环节、是同宫还是三方、有没有化科化权或吉星来制，单点受煞不等于整格尽毁。

cnTitle: 紫微坐命：帝王星也怕孤立无辅，会不会用人决定上限
enTitle: Zi Wei in the Life Palace: Even the Emperor Star Fears Standing Alone
enDesc: Zi Wei governs command, dignity and vision, with a natural ability to lead and set direction; but a lone emperor becomes image-conscious and deaf to advice, so its ceiling depends on aides such as Zuo Fu and You Bi.
cnDesc: 紫微主统御、尊贵与主见，天生有带队和定方向的能力，但孤君无辅时容易好面子、听不进话，上限取决于有没有左辅右弼这类班底。

cnTitle: 天机坐命：灵活善变是天赋也是内耗，怎么把聪明用稳
enTitle: Tian Ji in the Life Palace: Flexibility Is a Gift and a Drain—How to Steady a Quick Mind
enDesc: Tian Ji governs intelligence, planning, learning and adaptability—quick and idea-rich—but its changeable nature brings overthinking and short-lived enthusiasm; assistants and process are needed to settle the mind.
cnDesc: 天机主智慧、策划、学习与应变，脑子快、点子多，但天机化气为善变，想太多、换太快时容易内耗和三分钟热度，需要辅星与流程来定心。

cnTitle: 贪狼坐命：多才多欲不是缺点，关键看欲望往哪导
enTitle: Tan Lang in the Life Palace: Versatility and Desire Are Not Flaws—It Depends Where Desire Is Directed
enDesc: Tan Lang governs desire, networking, talent and opportunity—a romance and wealth star with strong energy and broad interests. Directed into career and skill it builds; into indulgence it drains. Channel, do not suppress.
cnDesc: 贪狼主欲望、人际、才艺与机会，是桃花星也是财星，能量强、兴趣广；欲望导向事业才艺则多成，导向享乐放纵则多耗，关键在疏导而非压制。

cnTitle: 七杀坐命：将星的刚是开创力，也是孤独感
enTitle: Qi Sha in the Life Palace: The General Star's Toughness Is Both Pioneering Power and Loneliness
enDesc: Qi Sha governs resolve, pioneering, independence and charge—strong action and load-bearing capacity—but too much rigidity breaks and dislikes asking for help, turning life into a lone fight; the lesson is borrowing strength and softening.
cnDesc: 七杀主决断、开创、独立与冲锋，行动力强、能扛事，但过刚则易折、不喜求助，容易把人生活成孤军奋战，功课是学会借力与柔软。

cnTitle: 天梁坐命：荫星清贵，为什么越老越值钱
enTitle: Tian Liang in the Life Palace: The Sheltering Star Grows More Valuable With Age
enDesc: Tian Liang governs shelter, principle, turning misfortune around and maturity—a noble elder star. It may be quiet or even lose out young, but with experience and expertise, reputation and blessing thicken after midlife.
cnDesc: 天梁主荫护、原则、逢凶化吉与老成，是清贵的老人星，年轻时可能不显甚至吃亏，随着阅历和专业沉淀，中年后声望与福气越来越厚。

cnTitle: 主星坐夫妻宫怎么看另一半：看的是关系模式，不是寻人启事
enTitle: How to Read the Major Star in Your Spouse Palace: It Shows a Relationship Pattern, Not a Person Wanted Ad
enDesc: The major star in the Spouse Palace describes who you are drawn to, how intimacy unfolds and where it snags—a pattern and lesson, not the partner's exact face or job.
cnDesc: 夫妻宫主星描述的是你容易被哪类人吸引、亲密关系以什么方式展开、会卡在哪，它给的是相处模式和功课，不是对方的精确长相或职业。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数十年大限和本命盘是什么关系：底盘不变，舞台轮换
enTitle: The Relationship Between the Ten-Year Decade Limit and the Natal Chart in Zi Wei Dou Shu
enDesc: The natal chart is a lifelong base that never changes; the decade limit is a main stage that rotates every ten years and is read layered over the natal chart. The natal sets possibilities, the decade sets when they cash out.
cnDesc: 本命盘是一生不变的底盘，大限是每十年换一次的主舞台，大限宫位叠在本命盘上解读，本命定可能性、大限定哪个阶段兑现。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数流年落宫怎么定今年的主题：流年命宫走到哪，哪类事上台
enTitle: How the Annual Palace Sets This Year's Theme in Zi Wei Dou Shu
enDesc: The annual Life Palace lands on a natal palace by the year's earthly branch and combines with that palace's stars to set the year's main scene; annual transformations and its trine then pin down which matter rises or falls.
cnDesc: 流年命宫按当年地支落在本命盘某宫，叠加该宫原有星曜，决定这一年的主场景，再看流年四化与三方，定今年具体在哪件事上起伏。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数大限好但流年差怎么办：顺境十年里的回调年怎么过
enTitle: What to Do When the Decade Is Good but the Year Is Difficult in Zi Wei Dou Shu
enDesc: During an upward decade, a year triggered by Ji or malefics is a short-term correction within a larger trend, not the end of a good ten years; the strategy is defend the core, cut leverage and wait for rhythm to return.
cnDesc: 大限走上升期、个别流年却遇化忌或煞星引动，属于大趋势中的短期回调，不是十年好运被推翻，策略是守核心、降杠杆、等节奏回来。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数双忌叠加怎么办：大限忌和流年忌同打一处时怎么防
enTitle: How to Handle Double Ji Stacking in Zi Wei Dou Shu When Decade Ji and Annual Ji Hit the Same Place
enDesc: When decade Ji and annual Ji land in the same palace or clash across, that field faces concentrated pressure that year—a year to defend proactively by spotting it early, lowering exposure and holding the line rather than charging.
cnDesc: 大限化忌与流年化忌落同一宫或对冲时，这一领域当年压力集中，属于需要主动防守的年份，重点是提前识别、降低投入、守住底线而不是硬冲。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数准吗：它能描述倾向，不能替你做决定
enTitle: Is Zi Wei Dou Shu Accurate? It Describes Tendencies, It Does Not Decide for You
enDesc: Zi Wei Dou Shu is a tool describing temperament, timing and probability structures. Its accuracy depends on a correct chart, the reader's skill, and whether you treat it as reference or verdict.
cnDesc: 紫微斗数是一套描述性格倾向、阶段节奏与概率结构的工具，准不准取决于排盘是否正确、解读者水平，以及你把它当参考还是当判决书。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数早子时晚子时为什么差一张盘：跨日的那道线
enTitle: Why Early and Late Zi Hour Produce Different Zi Wei Charts: The Line Across Midnight
enDesc: The Zi hour spans 23:00–01:00; 23:00–24:00 belongs to the current day (late Zi) and 00:00–01:00 to the next (early Zi). Crossing midnight changes the day pillar and Life Palace, so ignoring this split can produce a wrong chart.
cnDesc: 子时跨23点到1点，23到24点属当日晚子时、0到1点属次日早子时，跨日会换日柱和命宫，排盘时不分早晚子时，整张盘都可能错。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数和八字有什么区别：两套模型看的是不同层面
enTitle: Zi Wei Dou Shu vs BaZi: Two Models Looking at Different Layers
enDesc: BaZi uses stems, branches and five-element generation to read qi and life structure; Zi Wei uses stars in twelve life-affair palaces for concrete life domains and events. They complement but do not share rules.
cnDesc: 八字以天干地支、五行生克看气场与一生结构，紫微以星曜落宫、十二人事宫看具体生活面向与事件，两者可互参但不能混用规则。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数新手先背星还是先学看盘：正确顺序是先骨架后填星
enTitle: Should a Zi Wei Beginner Memorize Stars First or Learn to Read First? Skeleton Before Stars
enDesc: Beginners often drown memorizing star traits. The right path is the skeleton of twelve palaces and triple-direction first, then fill in stars on your own chart, and only then learn transformations, patterns and cycles.
cnDesc: 新手最容易陷进背星性的泥潭，正确路径是先懂十二宫和三方四正的骨架，再拿自己的盘边看边补星，最后才学四化格局与大限流年。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数看财运为什么不能只盯财帛宫：命财官迁要一起看
enTitle: Why Reading Wealth in Zi Wei Dou Shu Means More Than the Wealth Palace: Life, Wealth, Career and Travel Together
enDesc: The Wealth Palace only describes cash style; where money comes from is Career, whether you keep it is Life and Karma, and outside opportunity is Travel. Real wealth is the net result of the Life-Wealth-Career-Travel line.
cnDesc: 财帛宫只写现金方式，钱从哪来看官禄、能不能留住看命宫与福德、外部机会看迁移，真正的财运是命财官迁这条线的净结果。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数怎么判断适不适合换工作：官禄命宫迁移大限一起判
enTitle: How Zi Wei Dou Shu Judges Whether to Change Jobs: Career, Life, Travel and the Decade Together
enDesc: A job change is not just whether the Career Palace looks good; combine Life for fit, Travel for outside opportunity, and the current decade and annual transformations to tell whether you need a new platform or stronger skills.
cnDesc: 换工作不能只看官禄宫好坏，要结合命宫的适配、迁移的外部机会、当前大限与流年四化，判断是「该换平台」还是「该补能力」。
